description:
Welcome to Your Perfect Home in Bernal Heights!
Nestled in the picturesque neighborhood of Bernal Heights, this charming, eclectic farmhouse offers a seamless blend of vintage charm and modern comfort. Designed for long-term stays, this fully furnished home caters to families, remote workers, and anyone seeking an extended escape to San Francisco.
Key Features:
A Chef's Dream Kitchen: The kitchen is truly a standout, designed for those who love to cook. Featuring professional-grade appliances and some commercial elements, it's fully equipped for preparing everything from gourmet meals to everyday favorites. Ample counter space, high-quality cookware, and tools make it ideal for serious chefs and food enthusiasts alike.
Spacious Accommodations: With four bedrooms and cozy common areas, there's room for everyone to relax. The home comfortably sleeps up to 6 guests in real beds, ensuring restful nights.
High-Speed Internet: Stay connected with reliable Wi-Fi, perfect for remote work, online meetings, or streaming your favorite shows.
In-Unit Laundry: Long-term stays are made easier with convenient in-house laundry facilities.
Neighborhood Highlights:
Located in the heart of Bernal Heights, the home is surrounded by the best of San Francisco living. Enjoy a short walk to Bernal Heights Park for breathtaking views of the city skyline, or explore the vibrant local scene featuring cafes, artisanal shops, and a bustling farmers' market. The area is both peaceful and connected, providing the perfect balance.
Additional Amenities:
Dedicated Workspace: A quiet, comfortable area ideal for working from home or studying.
Monthly Cleaning Service: To maintain the home's comfort and cleanliness, a mandatory monthly cleaning service is provided for a nominal and reasonable fee.
Outdoor Space: A quaint patio/yard area perfect for morning coffee or unwinding in the evening.
Booking Details:
This fully furnished rental is available for stays of 30 days or longer, with flexible lease options to suit your needs. Whether you're relocating, working remotely, or simply looking for an extended getaway, this home is ready to provide the perfect base for your stay in San Francisco. Available for up to 6 months
WE PREFER NON-SMOKERS! Absolutely no smoking anywhere on the property, not even in the back yard
So please tell us a little about yourself and the reason for your stay here.
